content.description: Diagram showing upper and lower main bearing positions for cylinder positions No. 1 and No. 2-7. No. 1 shows 25 mm (0.98 in.) spacing, No. 2-7 shows 22 mm (0.87 in.) spacing.

content.text: 1. INSTALL UPPER MAIN BEARING IN CYLINDER BLOCK

items: (a) Place the upper main bearing in the block.
(b) Install the upper thrust washers on the center main bearing with the oil grooves facing out.
(c) Lubricate the faces of the bearings with engine oil.

content.description: Illustration showing hands installing a component into the cylinder block assembly.

content.text: NOTE: Each bearing cap is numbered.
(a) Install thrust washers on No. 4 bearing cap with the oil grooves facing out.

content.description: Top-down view of cylinder block showing numbered bearing cap positions 1-14 with arrows indicating installation direction and sequence.

content.text: (b) Install the bearing caps in numbered order with arrows facing forward. Tighten the bolts to the specified torque in the sequence shown and in two or three passes.

content.description: Illustration showing dial gauge measurement of crankshaft thrust clearance with a screwdriver prying the crankshaft.

content.text: (c) Install the dial gauge and measure the crankshaft thrust clearance while prying the crankshaft back and forth with a screwdriver.
4. INSTALL PISTON AND CONNECTING ROD ASSEMBLY
(a) Lubricate the cylinder bore and the crankshaft pin with clean engine oil.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of piston and connecting rod assembly into cylinder using a ring compressor tool.

content.text: (b) Using a ring compressor, push the correctly numbered piston and rod assembly into each cylinder. Make sure the notch and mark are facing forward.
